title: Isolation Forest Anomaly Detection
description: Tree-based unsupervised algorithm isolating anomalies based on shorter average path lengths in random partitions.
conditions: Multivariate numerical feature spaces (5 to 100 features)
Complex non-linear relationships and interactions where univariate thresholds fail
Large tabular datasets requiring linear time complexity O(N)
recommended_methods: Sub-sampling size set to 256 instances to prevent swamping and masking
Contamination parameter tuning based on expected anomaly budget
selection_rules: Default to Isolation Forest for general tabular multivariate anomaly detection tasks
Set contamination parameter to estimated outlier proportion (e.g. 0.01 for 1% anomaly rate)
Inspect average decision path length: score < 0.5 indicates normal, score approaching 1.0 indicates definite anomaly
limitations: Axis-aligned splits can create ghost anomaly regions in multi-dimensional space (extended Isolation Forest solves this)
Does not natively explain which specific feature caused an observation to be flagged
